01 / THE BRIEF

One dashboard for the whole canteen.

The Canteen Management System puts everything an operator needs on one dashboard: total students, meals served today, inventory items and student complaints, each linking through to its own list.

FlutterDartPHP APIDatabaseAndroid StudioGradle
“Validate on the device, then trust nothing on the server.”
THE BUILD PRINCIPLE
02 / WHAT I BUILT

Forms that refuse bad data.

The student module captures Student ID, password, name, contact and centre details, and validates them before anything reaches the API.

  • Password: 6–8 characters, starts with an uppercase letter and includes a special character.
  • Contact number: exactly 10 digits.
  • Centre: Center ID and Center Name are required.
  • Dashboard shortcuts: View Students, Meal Log, View Item Types and Student Complaints.
Flutter UI→Validation→REST call→PHP API→Database

03 / THE TAKEAWAY

What it
taught me.
